description: Keys whose pt-BR text may stay the same as the English text: texts that are the same in both languages (codec names, key names, numbers), and the texts that were not translated yet when tests/tools/i18n-check.js was added. Every key added later needs a Brazilian Portuguese translation. Remove a key from this list once it is translated.
keys: - Recovers from packet loss without a full keyframe, which avoids traffic spikes and blurry frames. Disable it if artifacts remain after a frame drop.
Allow the host to recover lost frames with reference frame invalidation (HEVC and AV1)

- Passes the HDR metadata of the host display (peak brightness, color primaries) to the TV with every HEVC keyframe, so its HDR tone mapping matches the host. Disable it if HDR streams fail to start or look wrong.
Send the HDR metadata of the host to the TV (HEVC)

Warning: HDR static metadata is experimental. If HDR streams fail to start or look wrong, disable it again!
